sceneDescription: On a bright supermarket checkout counter, a stack of oversized, gleaming gold bars sits on the conveyor belt next to a compact satellite dish and a modern point-of-sale card reader. A store clerk’s hand (out of focus) is just about to scan a gold bar with a barcode scanner. Tucked among the items, a reusable shopping bag peeks out with subtle NYTimes Technology, Payments Journal, and Glossy logos as store-brand tags. The surreal mix literalizes high gold prices (gold bars as everyday groceries), satellite internet (dish), and global payments (POS terminal), making the ordinary checkout process absurdly valuable.
